item: Row 429: every path that deletes articles moves the keyword counters in the same transaction
summary: Three paths delete articles. A source delete (ORM cascade) left Keyword.mention_count/article_count counting the deleted mentions until a whole sweep; it now reads the source's article ids and subtracts their unquarantined mentions under one hold of the write gate, committed by the strict epoch bump with the delete (a failed bump rolls both back). The live newsletter removal now moves the counters per chunk in the chunk's own transaction, so a removal that stops keeps every committed chunk exact; the closing whole refresh stays as the repair of older drift. The newsletter filter on a backup's snapshot copy (plaintext and the keyed encrypted path) recounts the touched keywords in the copy, so a backup no longer ships stale counters. Shared helper remove_deleted_articles_from_keyword_counters (R101: an already quarantined article is never subtracted twice). This also closes the cascade-delete stamp case disclosed in row 424. One test per path, each failing without the fix. No version bump, no schema change.
